title: DDC Construction Management Support Services
agency_path: City of New York > Design and Construction
description_text: Consultant to support its ongoing efforts to enhance how capital projects are managed and how vendor performance is evaluated. Acting as an extension of the Program Administration team and reporting directly to the Director of Program Administration, the Consultant will assist with strengthening internal practices that support consistent, efficient, and accountable project delivery. This engagement supports a broader modernization initiative focused on improving workflows, documentation, project closeout, and data practices that support transparency, consistency, and informed decision-making. The Consultant will help reinforce internal practices that enable staff to manage projects more effectively and support continuous improvement across teams.
